{{Quote|If the Ailon Nova Guard should somehow succeed in their objective (which did in fact occur during the Sundering of Slession), these assets can be preserved for their next mission.|General Rom Mohc, ''Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide''|<ref name="IH">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref>}}
The '''Sundering of Slession''' was a conflict<ref name="GaW" /> that occurred in the vicinity<ref name="Battlenamia" /> of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim's]] [[Slession system/Legends|Slession system]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and was fought at some point between [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] and [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> During the conflict, the [[Humanocentrism|Humanocentric]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] deployed the [[Ailon Nova Guard/Legends|Ailon Nova Guard]], the military force of the [[Ailon (species)/Legends|Ailon]] [[Species/Legends|species]], into what appeared to be a certain rout.<ref name="GaW" />

The Imperial [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanders]] did not expect the Ailon Nova Guard to attain its objective,<ref name="IH" /> with the Ailon forces usually being utilized to provide tactical insight into their enemy's composition and tactics through the former's decimation. However, the Nova Guard had at some point began adopting [[Scout/Legends|scouting]] and ambush tactics&mdash;as opposed to open assaults on entrenched opponents&mdash;and achieved an unlikely victory during the Sundering of Slession.<ref name="GaW" /> Imperial [[General/Legends|General]] [[Rom Mohc]] subsequently mentioned the Sundering of Slession in the ''[[Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]'', an [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] [[Book/Legends|manual]] published<ref name="IH" /> by 0 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].<ref name="Date" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Among the triumphs mentioned here are the "toppling of King Satyr Azzlectico" and the "Sundering of Slession." Both are newly-created and don't really refer to anything in particular.|Daniel Wallace|<ref name="Wallace">{{Blogspot|subdomain=geekosity|url=2009/09/endnotes-for-galaxy-at-war.html|name=Daniel Wallace's Geekosity|text=Endnotes for Galaxy at War|date=2009-09-26}}</ref>}}
The Sundering of Slession was introduced in a section of the [[2009]] [[Wizards of the Coast]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' sourcebook ''[[Galaxy at War]]''<ref name="GaW" /> authored by [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="Wallace" />
